24 engagements

Since 2008, HAYKALAH has modeled and structured land, housing, hotels, waqfs and the Holy Sites of Makkah and Madinah.

The economy of Makkah and Madinah is one of the four franchises in HAYKALAH’s record. Land, pilgrim housing, hotels, waqf estates and the Holy Sites: HAYKALAH has modeled and structured every layer. The archive census classes 24 engagements under Hajj, Umrah and the religious economy, and about 74 engagements in all were in the Two Holy Cities, across real estate, hospitality and other sectors.

Archive census counts are indicative. Clients are described, not named, until they consent in writing.

Holy Sites focus

Mina, Arafat and Muzdalifah, for a Holy Sites master developer:

  1. 2022

    Financing. HAYKALAH ran the bank process for over SAR 1bn of tents, water and power works. Five offers were compared, a Shariah-compliant facility was recommended and the files are signed.

  2. 2023

    Pricing. A pricing model per square meter per pilgrim, presented to the Ministry of Hajj and Umrah.

  3. 2026

    Tenders. Tender advisory on two plots totaling 346,466 m².

Recorded in HAYKALAH files; indicative.

What we do

  • Central-area land assembly with in-kind equity, so landowners join the project as partners.

  • Pilgrim-demand models and hotel room-rate studies.

  • Feasibility, valuation and debt-capacity studies for hotels, housing and mixed-use projects.

  • Mashaer pricing and financing: seasonal revenue, per-pilgrim pricing, and capital spending on tents and utilities.

  • Bank processes and tender advisory for Holy Sites developers.

  • Waqf structuring and the waqf-manager model: establishment, nazir governance and income distribution.

  • Capital structuring and company building for pilgrim-services companies.

  • Strategic and financial advice on the redevelopment of informal areas.

How we create value

  • 01

    Innovation

    HAYKALAH turned its waqf structuring since 2010 into a waqf-manager model that covers establishing a waqf, governing it through a nazir and distributing its income. NATHARAH, a HAYKALAH venture, is built on that model.

  • 02

    Monetization

    For the same developer, HAYKALAH prepared a Holy Sites pricing model per square meter per pilgrim (2023), and in Makkah it advised on the redevelopment of seven informal areas, about 3.67m m² (2024–25).

  • 03

    Optimization

    At the Holy Sites, HAYKALAH compared offers from five banks and recommended one facility for over SAR 1bn of tents, water and power works (2022).

Questions

What are the Mashaer?

The Holy Sites of Mina, Muzdalifah and Arafat, east of Masjid al-Haram, through which pilgrims move during Hajj.

What is a waqf-manager model?

A model for running waqfs: establishing the waqf, governing it through a nazir, and distributing its income as the waqf deed requires.

Why does this sector show 24 engagements when the Holy Cities record is larger?

The 24 are engagements classed under Hajj, Umrah and the religious economy. About 74 of HAYKALAH’s engagements were in the Two Holy Cities, across sectors such as real estate and hospitality.

Tell us about the land, the hotel, the waqf or the Holy Sites program. We can start under an NDA.
